about_the_game:
Farm, Explore, Survive!

Dive into the Crazy world of Little Farm Island, where the tranquility of farm life collides with a thrilling hidden mystery. Build your dream homestead, furnish your cozy home, and embark on quests that unveil the island's ancient secrets.

Plan Your Farms Before and Reap the Harvest Later

Cultivate your own crops and enjoy the fruits (and vegetables!) of your labor. If you have the resources, invest in pumpkin seeds and nurture them as they grow. Pumpkins will prove to be a valuable crop, providing sustenance for later consumption.

Meet colorful characters with unique stories and vibrant personalities

Will you build friendships or just exploit them for secrets? Get closer to the islanders and see what you uncover. Optional quests may reward you with clothes, food, and items to aid your survival. The choice is yours, and so are the rewards!

Handle Alcohol with Care, and drink Just Enough to Survive the day

Think twice before indulging in too much wine, beer, or drinks! Alcohol can quickly impair your character, leading to drunkenness. A drunk character means loss of control, clumsy actions, and generally being a complete mess on the island until they recover. Gameplay can become... challenging!

Play how you want, even if it means scavenging for food in the trash

Hunger can drive you to desperate measures, like digging through trash or eating wild plants. It's survival of the fittest! But a word of caution: not every plant on the island is your friend. Some are poisonous! So, be careful what you eat out there!

Beware of Cars on the road and other Physical damage

The island roads can be perilous! Be extremely careful to avoid traffic. Getting hit by a car will severely impact your health and could force you to seek medical attention at the nearest hospital. Road safety is key to survival!

Spooky Quests & Hidden Lore, a Story Unfolds Before Your Eyes

The narrative is woven into mysterious quests and more, waiting to be discovered. As you explore, you might encounter strange signs that trigger unsettling events, like a devil suddenly appearing to chase you, only to vanish moments later. These are just glimpses into the deeper mysteries that await those who dare to seek them out.

Your Island, your Story: Begin Your Adventure Today!

  • Arrive as a tourist and immediately embrace the freedom to forge your path on the captivating Pekena island.

  • Open-World Freedom: Explore every corner of a diverse open world, from towns to peaceful wilderness. The island is your playground: Go where you want, when you want.

  • Customization & Creativity: Craft your unique island life! Choose any character skin, design your dream home with personalized furniture, and build the farm you've always envisioned.

  • Survival Challenges: Will you thrive or just survive? Test your skills in managing resources like food, water, and health as you overcome the island's unexpected challenges and natural hazards.

  • Drivable Vehicle: Explore at your own pace, or put the pedal to the metal! Your drivable vehicle allows you to traverse the island and uncover even more hidden gems quickly.

  • Spooky Quests & Hidden Lore: (Remember to insert the Spooky Quests & Hidden Lore section with the GIF description here)

Immersive Atmosphere: Lose yourself in the island's tranquil atmosphere, surrounded by calming nature sounds and the simple joys of a unique, mystical world.

             

Your progress is safe! The game features a load/save system. All your items, money, and character skins are saved and restored next time when you load your game on the start.

         (Just a small detail: you'll need to quickly re-equip your skin after loading)

As a solo developer in Early Access, player feedback is incredibly important to me.

Thank you for your support and for helping to shape the future of Little Farm Island!

content_descriptors.notes:
Customers should be aware that Little Farm Island contains cartoonish violence and depictions of physical harm. While there are no sexual acts, the game does feature low-poly, cartoon-style violence, including blood effects and characters turning into skeletons when falling from great heights.  The game also depicts alcohol abuse, where characters can become drunk from consuming alcohol.  Furthermore, the game includes drug use, represented by characters injecting 'vaccines' to gain power-ups.

Please be aware that while the violence is not intended to be overly graphic or realistic, and is presented in a cartoon style, it does depict physical harm and some blood. The game also includes themes of alcohol and drug use, although not graphically or explicitly.

There is no depiction of sexual assault/non-consensual sex or BDSM content in this game. Self-harm is also not depicted.
